issue.title: Bug: URH downstream neighbors route-churn when using existing t2 j2 templates

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

Similar to #25727, while using the existing j2 templates for lrh (lrh-core.j2 -> t2-core.j2, lrh-leaf.j2 -> t2-leaf.j2), we are experiencing route churcning on downstream neighbors (LRH)

### Steps to Reproduce

Perform redeploy-topo + deploy-mg for URH device, wait a while for route churn to happen (may be more common after link flap or with fast LACP)

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Route churn shouldn't happen
